title: 7S.2c LEADER annotation target-index scratch compaction
scope: Reduce temporary per-entity-handle allocation in the LEADER annotation-target preflight.
Preserve unique-target pointer selection and duplicate-identity refusal semantics.

implementation.change: Replace unordered_map<uint32_t, vector<const DRW_Entity*>> with unordered_map<uint32_t, {first entity pointer, occurrence count}>. The count increment is checked before overflow.
preservedBehavior: Missing LEADER annotation target is rejected before destination publication.
Object-family and raw-entity handle collisions remain rejected.
A unique valid target is preallocated before record emission.
implementation.testBoundary: Generated ASCII/Binary writer/readback through dx_iface; no native producer or consumer qualification.

assessment.planImpact: Advances the existing 7S.2c local scratch/retention census by removing one inner vector allocation per unique valid entity handle in LEADER annotation preflight. The broader 7S.2c census and all external/native/semantic qualification remain open.

method.sourceFixturePolicy: The test generates temporary DXF input/output from scratch and removes it; no persistent DWG/DXF fixture is added.
method.commitReason: Git metadata is read-only in this workspace.
